content.short: Vana is a modular Layer 1 blockchain for user-owned AI, allowing individuals to monetize their personal data.
content.description:
Vana is a pioneering decentralized Layer 1 blockchain network specifically engineered to return ownership of personal data to individuals and transform it into a productive asset for the AI era. Originating from research at MIT, the platform enables users to pool their private data—such as social media history or health metrics—into "DataDAOs" (Data Liquidity Pools). These DAOs then selectively license high-quality datasets to AI researchers and developers, with contributors earning ownership and rewards in the resulting AI models.

By providing the essential infrastructure for verifiable and privacy-preserving data management, Vana ensures that individuals are fairly compensated for the information that powers modern intelligence. The network is built for high scalability and interoperability, fostering a vibrant ecosystem of data-driven applications across multiple sectors. Through its commitment to user sovereignty and technological innovation, Vana is building the foundational layer for a more resilient and meritocratic digital future, where data is treated as a globally accessible and community-governed utility.
content.meta: Vana provides a decentralized Layer 1 network for user-owned data monetization and AI model training.
